dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem: polynomial separator property for (prism, pyramid, theta, even wheel)-free graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is unknown whether (prism, pyramid, theta, even wheel)-free graphs have polynomially many minimal separators.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that a weakening of Conjecture 2.2 is obtained by restricting to (prism, pyramid, theta, even wheel)-free graphs (since prisms, thetas, and turtles all contain even holes). They explicitly state they 'were not able to prove that (prism, pyramid, theta, even wheel)-free graphs have polynomially many minimal separators,' which is why the main result (Theorem 2.3) additionally excludes squares.
